meta_description:
441 likes, 7 comments - hansajiyogendra on October 20, 2026: "It is easy to feel spiritual when life is quiet.

The deeper practice begins when responsibilities become heavy, people become difficult, and life does not go according to plan.

It is easy to run from responsibility. It is real yoga to stay, to hold it with steadiness, and to still find grace in it.

Yoga is not only about withdrawing from difficulty.
It is also about learning to remain balanced in the middle of it.

To do what needs to be done without resentment.
To stay steady without becoming rigid.

To carry responsibility without losing inner grace.
Sometimes, the situation itself becomes your practice.".
